units.source_text: 明石姬的花容月貌，叫源氏公子难分难舍。

en.t: Lady Akashi's flower-like beauty made Prince Genji unable to part from her.

units.source_text: 小女公子的娇姿，也使他百看不厌。

en.t: The little princess's lovely figure also made him never tire of looking at her.

units.source_text: 他想：“这孩子叫我如何安排呢？

en.t: He thought, "How should I arrange things for this child?

units.source_text: 让她在暗中生长，委屈了她，何等可惜！

en.t: If I let her grow up hidden away and wrong her so, what a pity that would be!

units.source_text: 不如带她到二条院去，给紫姬当女儿，

en.t: It would be better to take her to Nijo-in and let Lady Murasaki raise her as a daughter,

units.source_text: 可以尽心竭力地教养她。

en.t: so that she can be educated and brought up with the utmost care.

units.source_text: 将来送她入宫，也免得世人讥评。”

en.t: Then, if she is sent to court in the future, she will be spared the criticism of the world."

units.source_text: 然而又恐明石姬不肯，因此不便出口，只是对着这小娃娃垂泪。

en.t: Yet he feared that Lady Akashi would not agree, and so he could not bring himself to say it; he only shed tears before the little child.

units.source_text: 小女公子起初见父亲还怕羞，后来渐渐熟了，也对他说话，对他笑，与他亲近。

en.t: At first the little princess was still shy when she saw her father, but later she gradually grew used to him, spoke to him, smiled at him, and became close to him.

units.source_text: 源氏公子看了，越发觉得娇美可爱。

en.t: Seeing this, Prince Genji found her all the more graceful, beautiful, and lovable.

units.source_text: 他抱了她，这父女二人的姿态真漂亮！

en.t: When he held her in his arms, the sight of father and daughter together was truly beautiful.

units.source_text: 可知他们原有宿世因缘。

en.t: One could see that they had a bond from a former life.
